notes: from is Pontevedra (end of stage 8). Xunta de Galicia stage Pontevedra to Caldas de Reis, with Santa María de Alba, A Cancela and Albergue de Briallos on the way. Alba: the OSM civil parish 'Alba' (relation/12688970; the Xunta writes Santa María de Alba), 0.11 km from the route. A Cancela: hamlet node (Barro), 0.11 km from the route; the Igrexa de San Mamede da Portela (way/1154550106, cited by Vagamundos) is in the same place. Briallos: civil parish relation (Portas), 0.25 km from the route. Caldas de Reis: place=town node from Photon. Cerponzons (Vagamundos) gave no Nominatim result near the route. coastal is true because the first kilometres leave Pontevedra within 3 km of the Lérez estuary (OSM coastline 0.36 km from a point in the city). The Variante Espiritual (relation 6259246) leaves the Central at Pontevedra (general knowledge) and is excluded by route_exclude_regex. Checked against OSM relation 12786090 (Caminho Português de Santiago, ref CP), read through the OSM API on 2026-11-07: the 21.2 km between the two ends stay within 0.47 km of the straight lines through these points. Published figures seen, not copied into distance_km: Rother 23.0 km, Vagamundos 23 km.
